name: Nordmende CTG61BK — Gas (NG) Freestanding Cooker
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk. Photo to be confirmed.
description: The Nordmende CTG61BK is a 60cm twin-cavity natural-gas cooker in black. Four gas burners sit over a roomy 62L main oven with a 33L top grill cavity. Enamel pan supports, easy-clean enamel and button ignition keep it straightforward, with a mechanical timer. A energy rated, 3-year warranty.
features: Roomy 62L main oven + 33L top grill cavity
